justification: WORK ORDER update pass, check C5 as superseded 2026-09-09 (human-subject records: run block present?) and §2.3. Every entry in the tree that records a human state, reaction, or response is listed with its class and the five run-block fields backfilled ONLY from the record itself. A field the record does not support is the string 'unknown'. UNDETERMINED entries keep that class; they are not promoted to OBSERVATION. Existing logs are not modified; this index is the side-channel run-block record. Later backfills append a new dated *-human-subject-run-blocks.json.
class_rule: OBSERVATION = recorded during a declared run, with a measurand and a design (or named as such by the work order). CHARACTERIZATION = stated as a standing property of the person, outside any run. UNDETERMINED = inside a dated record but the run cannot be identified, or measurand/design are not declared; the expected mode on a first pass.
measurand_finding: Of 3 OBSERVATION entries, 1 declares a measurand (the 2026-06-20 calibration session). Of 16 UNDETERMINED entries, 0 declare what the reaction was recorded AS. Reactions were logged without a declared measurand — the same defect class this repo audits for elsewhere.
